drag: One panel moving over a still picture.
drag-over-canvas: The same drag over a canvas, which Safari draws in a layer of its own.
drag-half-stage: The same drag with half as much background behind it: how much of the cost is the background, not the glass.
drag-among-many: One panel moving while twelve other pieces of glass stay still: the cost of glass that did not change.
content-change: Still glass over content that repaints every frame.
scroll: A toolbar over a scrolling page of live text.
scroll-edges: The same scroll with progressive blur at both edges.
menu: A menu morphing open and closed three times.
controls: Glass inside glass: a tab indicator and a switch thumb moving.
resize: A panel changing size every frame, so its shape is drawn again and again. Memory is the number to watch.
reference-opaque: No glass: an opaque panel making the same drag. The cost of the page by itself.
reference-css-blur: No glass: a panel with a plain CSS backdrop blur making the same drag. The floor for any fallback that still blurs.
